messages:
mike: Heads-up: pattern where very-low-traffic shards show best latency and then collapse. Looking for a principled policy-engine mitigation.
anya: Observed same. Root cause is overconfident p95 from tiny sample counts.
reza: Two directions: shrinkage toward a prior OR add an uncertainty term into score (e.g., score += k / sqrt(n)).
mike: Prefer shrinkage + a tiny entropy floor so no shard appears 'too perfect'. Also a warmup admission limit to avoid thundering.
anya: Policy DSL should stay unchanged. Runtime exposes primitives: shrinkage(p95,n,prior_bucket), entropy_floor(min_score), warmup_tokens(k).
infra-bot: I can surface sample_count and prior_bucket in telemetry. Can add dashboard template.
reza: Plan: run 2-week sim with shrinkage vs shrinkage+entropy vs current. Then shadow scoring for 1 week, then canary.
mike: Tenant controls: coldstart_mode {conservative, default, aggressive} to let customers decide cheap-tier aggressiveness. SLA tenants keep affinity.
anya: Risks: biasing away from cheap tiers raises cost. Mitigate via tiny defaults and tenant opt-ins + monitor cost/tail-latency.
reza: Action items:
- runtime primitives (reza)
- telemetry & dashboard (infra-bot -> anya)
- sims + shadow scoring (anya)
- docs + FAQ (mike)
Sync next arch checkin with sim results. :white_check_mark:
